hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE -- 'git[^;&|]*[[:space:]]push[[:space:]][^;&|]*--force' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Force push detected. Approve manually if this is intentional (e.g. after a rebase)."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE -- '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]].*[;&][[:space:]]*git([[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: cd combined with git in one command. Use the git -C <path> <subcommand> form instead — it is already allowlisted and runs without a prompt. Re-issue the command with git -C."}}' || true
